title: caltha natans var. asarifolia
intro: Caltha natans var. asarifolia, commonly known as the Water Caltha or Asari-leaved Marsh Marigold, is a perennial aquatic plant belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Caltha natans var. asarifolia include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and reduce fever, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
